One first candidate attempt found an empty persisted source file, while a retry passed; the observed flake is archived. Three malformed-CArchive controls are rejected by the live isolated provider after cookie preflight (HTTP 400, no module payload): entry size below the fixed header, data position one byte beyond overlay, and entry extent beyond the complete TOC. A fourth malformed-typecode control initially returned HTTP 200 with 179 modules instead of 180. The extractor now validates CArchive typecodes, and the same artifact is rejected with HTTP 400 and no modules by revision 2aa0ec9e58317ac717fdeec84a02d5a67de7b96c2-reamon2; Docker Go tests pass. The new matrix receipt aggregator combines already-measured per-fixture pairs only when fixture coverage, per-side commit, evaluation and toolchain match; six Docker unit tests cover complete-set rejection, provenance drift, variable denominators and incomplete outcomes. It does not run fixture adapters, and no multi-format aggregate is yet measured. The provider returns bytecode, so source deobfuscation remains unavailable. These selected controls do not establish broad AR-0/AR-8 completion. Parser-level regression coverage now exercises actual CArchive TOC parsing and rejects unknown typecodes in the second and third entries after valid entries; the focused Go Docker suite passes. This strengthens the previously measured first-entry malformed-control fix but is not a new live fixture measurement or fidelity increment.
